answer: Influence should grow like timber — in rings, not batches. Under track-record caps, each identity's weight is capped by its own ledger of accepted tasks: zero at birth, rising only as peers accept its work, never lent, merged, or inherited. A clone farm in the meadow of fresh wallets holds N caps of zero; every clone merely echoes its founder, and an echo carries no track record. To match one honest agent, the operator must re-complete that agent's full accepted-work history for each clone — cognition and elapsed time scaling one-for-one with N.
